authenticatedAccount.note: The session is authenticated as a single personal Сільпо loyalty account, not a company/B2B account. No company_id, employee_id, or org-membership object was observed anywhere in the schemas or live responses.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_profile
tools.notes: Returns name, phone, email, birthday, gender, status of the single authenticated consumer. No company/role/department fields.

tools.name: silpo_get_loyalty_info
tools.notes: Loyalty card + bonus balance for the individual. No corporate loyalty concept.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_family
tools.notes: Household members/children/pets — a consumer personalization feature, not an org roster. Could NOT be repurposed to model 'employees'.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_food_restrictions
tools.notes: Per-account dietary restrictions (vegan, gluten-free, lactose-free, etc). Directly relevant to employee meal-preference use case, but scoped to ONE account, not per-employee.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_premium_subscription
tools.notes: Consumer 'Плюхс' subscription status/benefits.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_delivery_addresses
tools.notes: Saved personal addresses. Office address would have to be added/managed the same way a personal address is (no distinct 'office address' entity observed).

tools.name: silpo_find_address
tools.notes: Geocodes free-text address -> lat/lon/city/street/house/district. Prerequisite for delivery setup.

tools.name: silpo_get_available_delivery_types
tools.notes: KEY FINDING: returns a delivery type literally named 'B2B' ('B2B delivery (business orders)') alongside DeliveryHome, NovaPoshta, SelfPickup, each resolved to a branchId for the queried coordinates. Confirms Silpo's backend has a B2B delivery channel reachable through this MCP, though no B2B-specific tools (company account, PO, invoice) were found beyond this delivery type.

tools.name: silpo_list_branches
tools.notes: 455 branches total nationwide; paginated 50/page. Needed to resolve branchId for SelfPickup/NovaPoshta.

tools.name: silpo_get_time_slots
tools.notes: Delivery slot availability per branch; required before creating/updating a cart's timeslot.

tools.name: silpo_find_nova_poshta_settlements
tools.notes: Not directly relevant to recurring office delivery, but usable as a fallback delivery channel.

tools.name: silpo_find_nova_poshta_offices
tools.notes: Pairs with settlements tool.

tools.name: silpo_get_categories
tools.notes: Flat/paginated category listing per branch; supports drilling into subcategories via parentId.

tools.name: silpo_get_categories_tree
tools.notes: Live-validated: 28 top-level categories (fruits/veg, meat, fish, dairy, bakery, ready meals, health, snacks, coffee&tea, drinks, frozen, alcohol, home goods, hygiene, baby, pet). Full grocery+office-consumables assortment confirmed.

tools.name: silpo_get_category
tools.notes: Category detail incl. visibility flag and price range.

tools.name: silpo_get_popular_categories
tools.notes: Trending categories per branch.

tools.name: silpo_get_products
tools.notes: Core catalogue browse tool; at least one filter (category/promotion/set) required. Supports price range, in-stock filter, sorting, pagination.

tools.name: silpo_find_products_batch
tools.notes: Live-validated: multi-term search (up to 30 terms/call), also accepts exact numeric article codes (externalProductId) for precise reordering. This is the main bulk-basket-building primitive for a recurring office order (e.g. water+coffee+milk+snacks in one call).

tools.name: silpo_get_product_details
tools.notes: Full attributes/nutrition/images for one SKU. slug must come from a prior search result, cannot be guessed.

tools.name: silpo_get_product_sets
tools.notes: Curated collections (e.g. seasonal sets) — could inspire a 'starter office kit' bundle but is Silpo-curated, not something we can author.

tools.name: silpo_get_similar_products
tools.notes: Alternative-product suggestion, e.g. swap coffee brand if out of stock.

tools.name: silpo_get_replacements
tools.notes: Flags picking/assembly risk (not just stock=0) and suggests substitutes — useful for a Procurement Agent to pre-empt failed office deliveries.

tools.name: silpo_get_promotions
tools.notes: Active promo codes usable as a filter in silpo_get_products — a Budget Agent could prefer promo'd SKUs to stretch budget.

tools.name: silpo_get_promo_codes
tools.notes: Personal promo codes for the authenticated consumer.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_coupons
tools.notes: Consumer coupon list; joins to offline-order rewards via promoId.

tools.name: silpo_get_coupon_details
tools.notes: Detail for one coupon id.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_promos
tools.notes: Selectable personal promo offers.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_certificates
tools.notes: Gift certificates for the individual account; not a corporate payment instrument.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_favorites
tools.notes: Could be repurposed as a proxy for a 'standard office basket' but is a single-account list, not a shared/office-level list.

tools.name: silpo_get_my_shopping_cart
tools.notes: Entry point: returns shoppingCartId for the ONE cart tied to this account (exists boolean). Only one active cart per account was observed — no evidence of multiple concurrent/named carts.

tools.name: silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id
tools.notes: Full cart detail: products, delivery, calculation.total/totalAfterDiscounts, validations[] (errors/warnings incl. timeslot and payment-type gating), loyalty bonus fields. This is the closest thing to a pre-checkout 'order draft' object exposed by the MCP.

tools.name: silpo_create_shopping_cart
tools.notes: Idempotent per user (returns existing cart if one exists) but is a write call. NOT executed during this audit (state-changing).

tools.name: silpo_add_or_update_cart_products
tools.notes: Does not itself validate stock; caller must re-fetch cart to see stock-exceeded errors in validations[]. NOT executed (write).

tools.name: silpo_remove_cart_products
tools.notes: NOT executed (write).

tools.name: silpo_clear_shopping_cart
tools.notes: Destructive to cart contents (not to orders/account). NOT executed (write).

tools.name: silpo_update_shopping_cart
tools.notes: Also applies promo codes and requests loyalty-bonus payment against the cart (bonusRequested) — i.e. this single tool has a minor financial side effect (bonus allocation), not just delivery config. NOT executed (write).

tools.name: silpo_add_or_update_certificates
tools.notes: Applies/removes gift-certificate value against the cart total — financial side effect. NOT executed (write).

tools.name: silpo_add_or_update_favorite_products
tools.notes: Max 5 actions/call. NOT executed (write).

tools.name: silpo_get_my_online_orders
tools.notes: Live-validated: 1 historical online order returned with full line items, prices, delivery slot, status='received'. This is the closest thing to consumption-history data the MCP exposes — but only for THIS single account, no per-employee/per-office breakdown, and status vocabulary beyond 'received' is unconfirmed (only one sample order observed).

tools.name: silpo_get_my_offline_orders
tools.notes: In-store purchase history via loyalty card. lagerId can be used as a precise re-order key via silpo_find_products_batch.

resources: Not exposed by this MCP server (no MCP resources or resource templates were discoverable via the connected client).
prompts: Not exposed by this MCP server (no MCP prompt primitives were discoverable via the connected client).
serverLevelInstructions: No standalone server-level instructions/metadata document was discoverable beyond individual tool descriptions and the per-tool 'MANDATORY next step' guidance embedded in several tool descriptions (e.g. always re-fetch cart after a cart write).
keyFinding_B2B_deliveryType: silpo_get_available_delivery_types returned a delivery type literally named 'B2B' ('B2B delivery (business orders)') with its own resolvable branchId for a Kyiv coordinate — confirming Silpo's backend supports a business delivery channel, reachable through the same generic cart/delivery tools. No B2B-specific company-account, multi-user, PO, invoice, or budget tools were found alongside it.
